primary: Fixed harmonic tree versus single Gaussian with the same covariance approximation; matched source-SC training recipe and frozen existing harmonic/Gaussian references.
pilot_gate: Harmonic exceeds covariance Gaussian graph count in both existing training seeds and both panels; positive pooled conditional paired95 lower bounds on both panels. Report every comparison, geometry and diversity. Panels are now reused for a new control, not a second untouched confirmation.
failure_rule: No calibration-budget, source-scale, data, optimizer, sampler, or seed selection based on generated outcomes.
data_scope: Same audited TRAIN coordinate rows and composition exclusions; no scaffold or evaluation geometry used for fitting.
compute: One new model per seed,3000 two-pass updates,128 primitive inference calls on both existing panels. Frozen existing harmonic/Gaussian models reused.
source_control: 128-tree covariance Gaussian from the existing tested control implementation. Covariance calibration against8192 trees on all22 compositions is reported before any benefit is attributed beyond second moments.
claim_boundary: Development experiment only; fixed probabilistic source may be the contribution but no originality, held-out-composition, Boltzmann-law or ICLR-readiness claim follows automatically.
